description: Checks a finished game and returns the verified score, share text with emoji, and a challenge link a friend can open to play the same board. Records an anonymous play count for the site's stats; nothing about the user.

game.description: Which game, by id from list_games (for example "thunk").

hints.description: How many hints the player took.

number.description: Board number (No. 1 was the game's first day).

progress.description: Everything the player has done on this board from the start, in the game's own format (list_games describes each). Empty for nothing yet.

seconds.description: Time spent in seconds, if known.

name: game_result
title: Check the result
